title: Synchronize localized graphics and gameplay inventory translations
changes: Synchronize 31 localized graphics and gameplay lookup entries with existing English plan translations after checking their original text matches the inventory exactly.
validation: Compared both source blocks byte for byte with plan preimages and checked that task IDs, links, inline literals and numeric runs match their translations.
limitations: Other inventory sections and the wider cross-tree English-first audit remain open; no ROM access or runtime checks were performed.
